clinic_doc:
Sunrise Family Clinic, patient information.
Opening hours: Monday to Saturday 9:00 to 13:00 and 17:00 to 20:30; closed on Sunday and public holidays.
Please arrive 10 minutes before your slot with your appointment code and a photo ID. First-time patients also bring any previous prescriptions.
Consultation fees: general consultation 600; follow-up within 7 days of a consultation 300; senior citizens (60 and above) pay 450 for a general consultation. When two fees could apply, the lower one applies. Payment by cash, UPI or card.
Cancellations: free up to 2 hours before the slot. After three missed appointments, future bookings need a phone confirmation.
Reports: blood test reports are ready by 18:00 on the same day and are handed over at reception or sent through the app.
Vaccinations: the clinic gives routine adult vaccinations on Tuesdays and Fridays between 17:00 and 19:00; bring your vaccination record.
Parking: two-wheelers in the basement; cars at the municipal lot opposite, which is paid.
The clinic does not provide emergency services. In an emergency call 108.
